A: Size of the swing on the scale
F: Gravitational pull of a large sphere on a small one
G_corr: G corrected for the far sphere's pull
I: Moment of inertia of the two small spheres, 2ml²
L: Distance from the mirror to the scale
S_1: First of three successive turning points
S_2: Second of three successive turning points
S_3: Third of three successive turning points
S_n: Spot position at turning point n
beta: Share of the torque the far large sphere takes back
g: Free fall acceleration at Earth's surface
l: Half the beam's length: fiber to small sphere center
q: Factor by which each turning point is closer to the resting position
r: Center to center distance of a large and a small sphere
